items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: So now, Chris Kelly, he got an idea.

ctx.x: of course, they didn't want to give me the credit. I didn't want it, no, huh? Because all I was trying to do, take the ideas, you know, to get ahead of the other fella. I went to the, this must have been back in 1910 or 11, but way back then, got a coconut shell and cut it in half. Because you see, I've seen Buddy Petit, but the first one played, you know, with his derby. He was the first man ever played with a derby, you see, and him and another fella, Frederick Kepage, you all heard talking about Frederick…

items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Harrison bond used to be with Chris oh Chris Kelly yeah yeah

ctx.x: I've heard plenty of talk about it, he goes in and out of town, I can never go catch him.

Can't catch him, man. Well, anyhow, he used to play Alto. We used to have them upright Alto at that time, you see. And we used to Morris French, Zebra Norris, some clan there. And then he would hire, you know, hire other fellas, sometimes Chris or anybody else, whatever he could get, see. But they had Gut Bucket Band. Now, any time Black Bender would get a funeral, well, if he couldn't get a parade, he couldn't get us, he'd get somebody else.
